description: This file defines MIME utility functions for handling MIME types, including functions for getting MIME types from file extensions, parsing MIME types, matching MIME types, and generating multipart boundaries. It is part of the Chromium project and provides interfaces for MIME type operations within the net namespace.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieves MIME type associated with a file extension, returns true if found.

methods.name: GetWellKnownMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieves MIME type from a limited set of known extensions, returns true if found.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromFile
methods.description: Gets MIME type based on file path, returns true if successful.

methods.name: GetPreferredExtensionForMimeType
methods.description: Gets preferred file extension for a given MIME type.

methods.name: MatchesMimeType
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type pattern matches a given MIME type, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: ParseMimeType
methods.description: Parses a MIME type string into type and parameters.

methods.name: IsSupportedImageMimeType
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type is a supported image type (conditional on STARBOARD).

methods.name: ParseMimeTypeWithoutParameter
methods.description: Parses MIME type string with no parameters into top-level type and subtype.

methods.name: ExtractMimeTypeFromMediaType
methods.description: Extracts MIME type from a media type string, optionally accepting comma-separated types.

methods.name: IsValidTopLevelMimeType
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid top-level MIME type.

methods.name: GetExtensionsForMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves file extensions associated with a MIME type.

methods.name: GenerateMimeMultipartBoundary
methods.description: Generates a random boundary string for MIME multipart messages.

methods.name: AddMultipartValueForUploadWithFileName
methods.description: Prepares a multipart upload value with filename.

methods.name: AddMultipartFinalDelimiterForUpload
methods.description: Adds final delimiter to multipart upload data.
